ignorePatterns.comment: Exact page, not the host: socket.dev answers this one URL with a 503 bot challenge to the GitHub-hosted runner (403 from a workstation, which aliveStatusCodes already accepts), while https://socket.dev/supply-chain-attacks/canistersprawl resolves from the same runner. The link is real; the check cannot reach it. Do NOT add 503 to aliveStatusCodes and do not widen this to the host.

replacementPatterns.comment: Mintlify site-absolute route -> the .mdx file behind it. Assumes every /genie/<route> is backed by a same-named docs/<route>.mdx, which is true for every /genie/ link in the linted pages today. A route resolved by a directory index (/genie/config) or written with a trailing slash (/genie/installation/) would map to a path that does not exist and be reported dead; extend this pattern rather than deleting the link if such a route is ever linted.
